messages:
samir: Morning folks  urgent(ish) bug: sugar jar is empty but the little scoop is missing. Who embiggened the coffee? :eyes:
ellie: lol I used the last of it this morning and meant to top it up. no scoop here either  maybe someone pocketed it? Ben, did you borrow a metal scoop?
ben: Not me. I did borrow the espresso tamper yesterday but returned it. I can pick up a small scoop on my way in if nobody beats me to it. Also can we stop storing coffee filters in the top drawer? They get crushed by the office stapler.
zoe: I confess the tamper was mine, thanks for returning. Re: filters  yes please move to labeled box in pantry. Also tiny PSA: if you make a latte please wipe milk splatter off the counter  I found a science experiment by the sink. :nauseated_face:
frank: I'll bring a replacement scoop and a pack of travel coffee sticks. Also proposal: "Latte Swap" on Thursdays  someone volunteers to bring milk alternatives so you can taste different oat/almond options each week. Vote: yes/no?
samir: Love the latte swap. Vote yes. Also reminder: please don't pour used coffee grounds down the sink  clog city. Use the compost bin (small one under the grinder).
ellie: Noted. I'll make a tiny laminated sign for above the sink: "NO GROUNDS IN SINK" and stick it with a magnet.
kitchen-bot: Reminder scheduled: "Replace sugar scoop + restock filters" 2012349300. Poll created: "Thursday Latte Swap?" options: Yes, No. Poll ends 2012347800.
ben: Quick dietary note: if we do biscotti next week please label nut-containing ones. I'd vote muffins for variety though.
zoe: Poll: "Friday snack" options: Biscotti (traditional), Banana muffins (nut-free), Savory scones. I think muffins are the crowd-pleaser.
frank: I'll seed the snack jar with $5 for Friday. Also can someone check the coffee grinder settings  it seems a touch fine today and my espresso is bitter. Maybe dial coarser one click.
samir: @frank thank you for the seed. @ben I'll try to get a coarser grind in the afternoon. Also small request: if you microwave soup, put a plate under the bowl to catch drips. Microwaves should not be modern art.
ellie: Will do. Also who took the polka-dot takeaway cup? I thought it belonged to marketing but it's gone missing. :mag:
ben: I put it on the top of the fridge last week  maybe it slid behind the cereal boxes. I'll fetch it and return to the labeled shelf.
kitchen-bot: Shopping list updated: sugar scoop, coffee filters, magnet stickers, oat milk sample pack. Reminder: "Check grinder" 2012346600.
zoe: Final note: if you borrow snacks from the communal tub (granola, biscuits), add a quick sticky with initials. Helps avoid mystery snack drama.
frank: Ok scoop mission accepted. See you all at coffee o'clock. :coffee:
